quarterly_data.quarter: Unisplendour investor Q&A: SZSE Interactive Easy (10-12-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The company said on SZSE Interactive Easy: it continues building large compute clusters and supernode systems with several leading internet companies to support their core businesses and new AI applications. Supernode demand is not limited to large internet companies: other internet companies are actively testing, telecom operators have entered the testing stage, leading banks and other financial institutions are running test validation, and some large-model companies and large power-sector enterprises have shown strong demand intent. It said supernodes can be used for both large-model training and inference.

quarterly_data.quarter: Unisplendour investor Q&A: SZSE Interactive Easy (10-12-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The company said on SZSE Interactive Easy: since 2025 Alibaba Cloud and New H3C have jointly released a new-generation cloud-network converged solution for dedicated (private) cloud based on domestic chips, built around Alibaba Cloud's CPN architecture and H3C's high-performance networking, domestic-chip adaptation and fast productisation; it enables cross-node and cross-data-center compute scheduling, data interconnect and task coordination for government, enterprise, finance and research customers.
